options.text: Difference between operating and environmental temperature
Difference between operating and reference temperature

solution:
__**Concept:**__

An RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) works on the principle that the electrical resistance of a metal changes linearly with temperature over a limited range.

The relationship between resistance and temperature for an RTD is given by:

Rₜ = Rᵣₑf(1 + αΔt)

Where:

Rₜ = Resistance of the RTD at operating temperature
